definitions.day: days since the last day with 0.1 in or more of rain (day 0 = rain on the sample day)
definitions.dry: 8+ days since 0.1 in of rain, any month
definitions.normal: 8+ days since 0.1 in of rain, November-April (the comparison for recovery)
definitions.advisory: days 0-3 (LA County advises staying out for 72 hours after 0.1 in of rain)
definitions.clearly_above: the 95% range of (rate - normal rate) is entirely above zero; bootstrap over whole storms
definitions.trigger: smallest storm size where 1 in 4 tests on days 0-1 were unsafe (8+ tests), and every bigger size too
definitions.big_tide: daily tide range of 6.5 ft or more (Boehm & Weisberg 2005)
definitions.near_normal: within 5 points of normal and not clearly above it
